depends_on.description: Names of services this service depends on

shutdown_cmd.description: Shell command to run when fog shuts down (e.g. docker compose down)

reuse.description: Reuse this service across worktree switches. Only honored when the script has concurrent: false (single-instance mode): when another instance of the same project+script starts, this service's shutdown_cmd is skipped, a live process is handed over, and starting it is skipped if it is already up (verified via health_check).

share.description: Share this service between multiple concurrent instances of the script. Only honored when the script has concurrent: true: when another instance of the same project+script is already running and this service's health_check passes, the cmd is not re-run (the service is borrowed instead of duplicated), and it is torn down (shutdown_cmd) only when the last instance of the project+script exits.

compose_file.description: Compose file used by the `docker` health kind, relative to the service path (default: docker-compose.yml)
Compose file used by the `docker` health kind, relative to the service path (default: docker-compose.yml)

concurrent.description: Allow multiple concurrent instances of this script in the same project+branch. When true (default), running the script again starts alongside existing instances instead of killing them; services flagged share: true are shared between those instances. When false, only one instance runs and a new run kills the previous one first (with reuse: true services handed over).

dnsmasq.description: Wildcard DNS routes set up through dnsmasq automatically on startup. Each domain is mapped so any *.<domain> hostname resolves to the configured address.

domains.description: Domains to wildcard-map, e.g. ['red-fox'] makes main.red-fox resolve to 127.0.0.1

port.description: Port dnsmasq listens on (default: 53). On macOS the daemon runs as a root LaunchDaemon so it can bind this privileged port; the /etc/resolver zone file uses a plain nameserver line.

router.description: Central reverse proxy (Traefik) set up automatically on startup. A single host-level instance shared across every project and branch, so apps do not run their own (which would collide on the published port). Apps opt in by attaching to the shared network and declaring Traefik labels.

hostname.description: Hostname for the Traefik dashboard (e.g. router.red-fox). Must be covered by dnsmasq.domains.

dashboard_port.description: Host port for the Traefik dashboard

shared_network.description: Name of the external Docker network shared with app services

index_port.description: Port of the standalone service-directory index server. Requests to the router with no matching app host are served the generated index.html (listing running services, their hostnames and the port DNS forwards to) from here.

tls.description: Optional HTTPS termination on the central router. When enabled, fog generates local-CA wildcard certificates (mkcert) for the dnsmasq domains plus the router hostname and localhost, and Traefik serves them on a :443 websecure entrypoint. HTTP on :80 keeps working.

enabled.description: Enable HTTPS termination on the central router

cert_dir.description: Directory where wildcard certificates are stored (default: ~/.config/fog/certs). Requires mkcert (brew install mkcert; mkcert -install once).

index.description: Standalone service-directory index server (web UI + JSON API). Controls whether starting this project serves the index. Default enabled: true, so every `fog <script>` brings the index up unless explicitly disabled per-project.

enabled.description: Whether to serve the index server when this project starts. Default true. Set to false to opt this project out of serving the index (other projects can still serve it).

port.description: Port the index server listens on (default 18080). Overrides router.index_port when set.
